doc.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Quietly There and Morgan Ames
summary: Mandel says Quietly There was source music in Harper, with a later lyric by Morgan Ames, with whom he also wrote Unless It's You.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: It’s just a song that I wrote…
Yeah, yeah. I didn’t really write it for, Harper, it’s just something that I came up with and I put it into, Harper, as a piece of source music but it wasn't really written for that movie.
The lyric is by Morgan Ames right?
Is that the only song that you wrote with her?
No, no. We wrote, “Unless It’s You,” and we just now wrote something, just finished a song called, “Life in My Eyes,” brand new song.
